messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: primary-east1 GPU pool reporting sustained queue growth > 80% for 7m, autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (errors: quota_denied). Investigating. /runbook spillover
sara: acked. oncall paging in 2. assigning lead: @matt
matt: oncall here. seeing queue spike on inference-service->primary-east1, p90 latency up from 120ms to 2.4s. requests piling in the main queue, tokens/sec dropping. pulling autoscaler logs now.
matt: autoscaler logs -> `error: failed to request GPUs: quota exceeded: requested 4gpus, available 0` . sounds like cloud quota for east1 is exhausted. also seeing a flurry of throttles: 429s from router.
lee: adding context — we merged a perf test earlier that temporarily increased parallelism in east1; might have consumed ephemeral quota. can we do geo-fallback to east2 while we sort quota?
jordan: confirmed autoscaler backoffs: `backoff: exceeded max_retries, last_error=quota_denied`. it keeps retrying smaller batches but queue > 3k.
anita: recommend immediate mitigation: 1) enable cross-region fallback routing to east2 with 35% traffic shift, 2) mark primary east1 as degraded so canary routes avoid it, 3) manually provision 2 reserved instances in east1 if quota allowed, otherwise surge in east2.
sara: @opsbot can you apply route-split for primary-east1 -> east2 at 35%? runbook step B says to call routing API.
opsbot: running command: ```bash
# update route split
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/split \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"from":"primary-east1","to":"east2","weight":0.35,"reason":"autoscaler_quota_exhausted"}'
```
opsbot: routing update in progress... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
opsbot: routing change applied — primary-east1 -> east2 weight=0.35. new split will take effect within ~30s. :white_check_mark:
matt: seeing immediate drop in east1 queue rate: requests being steered. p95 latency for east1 still high but overall platform p95 improving. good.
jordan: we still need to remediate autoscaler in east1. quota request to cloud sent (ticket: CL-4521). ETA unknown. proposing additional rate-limiter at edge to slow non-critical background traffic to avoid repeat.
emily: notifying support and PS teams. preparing a short public blurb for status page: "We are investigating increased latencies for customers in east US; traffic is being routed to alternate region to mitigate impact." will post in 10m unless there are changes.
customer-impact-bot: Customer impact summary: ~4% of requests returned 429s during peak window. Top affected customers: alpha-app (east1-heavy), beta-ml-pipeline. Estimated 2.3k failed requests in last 10m. Severity: P2 depending on SLAs. Logged to CI-INC-998.
lee: small ops idea — enable prefix KV cache warmup on east2 for hot models to reduce cold-start token cost while new capacity ramps up.
anita: executing manual mitigation: attempted to provision reserved in east1 but quota denied. instead spun up two surge nodes in east2 and increased capacity there (token: surge-apply-775). verified model variants available.
matt: routing steady. queue length trending down from 3.1k -> 420 in 12m after split and east2 surge. continuing to watch.
sara: handoff to next oncall at 2754000300. @lee you'll take follow-up rotation for the next hour, please lead remediation and coordinate with cloud quota team.
lee: taking it. will keep a 15m cadence updates here. next steps: try quota escalation with account team, add autoscaler guard so it stops hammering backoff retries, create alert for quota_denied spikes.
emily: status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/CI-INC-998 (note: initial blurb). Support notified with workaround steps for affected customers.
opsbot: reminder: enable post-incident tasks: `task:create` "investigate autoscaler retries & quota handling" assignee:@jordan priority:high
jordan: logging requested metrics and saving autoscaler debug logs to /logs/incidents/2754000000.tar.gz
customer-impact-bot: follow-up: flagged customers contacted: alpha-app (account rep pinged), beta-ml-pipeline (support ticket opened). ETA for full recovery depends on quota approval; if cloud quota not resolved, we'll keep geo-steer until next deployment.
sara: closing active page; keeping the thread open for postmortem notes. Great mitigation work. action items: quota alert, routing fallback test coverage, autoscaler backoff tweak. will file a concise postmortem template in #postmortems.
lee: note for postmortem — add test to simulate regional quota exhaustion and validate geo-steer behavior + alerting thresholds.
opsbot: Incident resolved? status: mitigated (traffic shifted + east2 surge). Keep as follow-up for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
